interpretation: The fine-tuned model produced valid JSON for all 100 test examples.
The base model often used a different schema from the expected assessment format.
The fine-tuned model achieved substantially higher exact-match agreement with the reference outputs.
Agreement with reference outputs does not independently establish factual correctness.
limitations: Exact match is strict and does not measure partial correctness.
The reference outputs have not all been independently verified.
Generation time was not benchmarked under controlled, identical conditions.
